worlds.name: Machina
worlds.description: A sprawling megacity inhabited by robots.
worlds.clue: Bart's transmission crackles: 'The robots won't give me any pats!'
worlds.search_scene: You land among the towering metal buildings. Robots help you search the city.

worlds.name: Sirocco
worlds.description: A desert world of dunes and sandstorms.
worlds.clue: Bart's transmission crackles: 'There's sand in my fur and in the ship!'
worlds.search_scene: You cross the dunes, checking behind rocks as sand blows around your boots.

worlds.name: Gloam
worlds.description: A dark, spooky world wrapped in mist.
worlds.clue: Bart's transmission crackles: 'I can't see through this mist. Was that a ghost?'
worlds.search_scene: You step into the mist, calling for Bart. Something rustles in the darkness.
